header: The page's extended plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, at most 5 minutes with every timeout counted,
for when a longer play than the regular one (tools/play_plan.json) is needed: the launcher, Load ROM on a new profile
once the page has its shader list (Chrome builds the whole list behind the launcher, and says when it is done; Firefox
builds none there, and says so as the launcher comes up), Start Game and the logos. Then four places in one load, each
started by tools/shader_survey.js's surveyWarp as the game's own map select does, with the debug save (every item and
mask) on the first morning, and each checked before it is played: a need that fails the run unless the play state's
scene (surveyScene()) is the one asked for. Link's health is kept full the whole time. Termina Field outside Clock
Town's south gate: Link runs out into the field and then about 30 s about there, walking to and fro, turning, swinging
the sword and targeting, clear of the gate, which takes him back into town. Then Woodfall Temple's entrance room as
human Link, Great Bay Coast as Zora Link and Goron Village in winter as Goron Link, about 30 s each: Link sways out
and back about where he arrived with Z held, so he steps without turning (forward and back, to each side and back; at
Great Bay Coast, which he enters by the gate from the field, more forward than back), then swings B, targets with Z
and holds R. From the first warp on, its waits and holds are on the game's own clock, the play state's gameplayFrames
(20 a second, through sCamPlayState; each new play state starts it at 0, which the wait after a warp counts from), so
every browser walks Link as far whatever frames it gives the game; each place ends by reading where Link is (the
player actor's world.pos), and each of the last three the scene he is in. A picture of Termina Field is taken 8 s in
and of each other place 6 s in. The whole play is 2-5 minutes with every timeout counted: the shader list is waited
for 60 s at most, each place is played for less rather than leaving one out.
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|the game waiting for the \d+ of section
play: (() => { window.sceneIs = async (id, name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) { if (surveyScene() === id) return name + ', scene 0x' + id.toString(16); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('scene 0x' + surveyScene().toString(16) + ' plays, not ' + name + ' (0x' + id.toString(16) + ')'); }; window.keepAlive = window.keepAlive || setInterval(() => n64w(0x801EF6A4, (0x140 << 16) | 0x140), 250); return 'sceneIs, keepAlive'; })()
